title: Great!
text: Excellent tour! The guide was knowledgeable, kind, and organized. He shared historical insights with passion.  A+ experience!
author: John_B

title: Fantastic Experience
text: The size of the Alhambra beggars believe. The whole experience is amazing from the gardens, terraces and patios to the ornate interiors. Appreciate  the architecture  and craftsmanship on a grand scale. A true cultural experience.  Our three hour guided tour was excellent.
author: lamkin93

title: Take local certified guide
text:
A bit on expensive side booking with GetYourGuide.
Entry was smooth with tour guide, crowded for single entry.
Nice experience, unexpected impact of Generalife.
Take certified guide, like Marta Soler, she has good local history knowlege and make your tour very interesting.
author: gorant870

title: It's meaningless without the tour :)
text:
Our guide, Marta Soler, was very attentive, understanding, and informative.
Thank you for your interest…
author: 213koraya

title: Awe inspiring visit - a must do!
text: Although our guide was running late, and had an issue with 3 other visitors in our group not having their paperwork in line, he managed to fix the situation, and made the most of our time in the Alhambra.  We also encountered rain, but that never stopped the commentary and knowledge.  Unfortunately I cannot recall our guide's name, but he was extremely knowledgeable about the history and religions, and very passionate about passing this on to us.  Well done Señor.
author: Destination548584

title: Alhambra visit with Marta Soler
text: Our guide, Marta, was very good and helpful.  Exhaustive and very competent, she finished the visit in about 3 hours as scheduled.  Very punctual, which is always a good thing when you have limited time. Highly recommended. Thanks a lot Marta!
author: brunobH2898SX

title: Fascinating tour of Alhambra
text: The tour was very informative. It was good to arrive early with few other tourists. We appreciated the 15 minute comfort break.
author: Paula_H

title: Amazing place
text: Emilio was an excellent guide to a magnificent location. Absolutely worth doing.
author: Pioneer11456989220

title: Well Worth It
text: The tour is well worth the time and money. If you get a chance pick Emilo as your guide (English tour). He is not only VERY knowledgeable but paces the tour for all, which important in summer heat.
author: ALLEN_J

title: Great tour, friendly slow pace
text:
Marta was a great guide and we enjoyed the slow paced friendly walk. We were a small group so plenty of time to chat and take pictures.
It was hot but we took breaks and didnt feel rushed at all despite the crowds.
author: xs2reemaa
